card.name: Leading digit of a split number
card.fires_on: The digit 1 or 2 that starts a number after a comma or dash in a list, usually where the rest of the number follows as a separate piece. Seen in year lists, archive date ranges and percentage lists.

modes.label: Years in lists
modes.description: The first digit of a year in a list or range of dates.

modes.label: Counts and percents
modes.description: The first digit of a figure in a list of percentages or counts.
